title: Mass of a restriction is at most the mass of the current on W ⊂⊂ U
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, W ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContainedOpen W U: W open, closure W compact, closure W ⊆ U), A ⊆ ℝ^P, and X, S ∈ D_k(U) such that S is a restriction of X to A (IsRestriction X A S). Then M_W(S) ≤ M_W(X).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U W A : Set (Eucl P)) (X S : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsOpen U → CompactlyContainedOpen W U → IsRestriction X A S → S.massOn W ≤ X.massOn W
